Gender bending or race bending established characters is a pet peeve of mine. It's simply uncalled for. There is zero reason for it. And it shows a complete disrespect for the fans of the character, the integrity of the fiction, and the intent of the original author.

Now obviously this isn't true for all characters. If we're talking about a game where you get to make your own character and choose how they behave in the world, go nuts. But when you take a very predefined character, with a set personality, history and relationships, and gender or race bend them just because... it's fucking stupid.

There is a reason retconning is so despised in fiction. And whether you retcon somebody back to life, or retcon how they came to exist, or retcon their race or gender, it's still retconning and it's still stupid.

A while ago I read an article advocating that Magneto be made black... Thus erasing his Jewish heritage as a Holocaust survivor. That doesn't make any sense. I'd much rather see an original black character than have Magneto, who's fascinating enough on his own, be re-made as black.

I'm not a purist- I don't have anything against seeing a white character as black in a reboot of something or whatever- but it strikes me as lazy to say "There. We've made this character black. You have diversity now, congratulations!" That's not how it should work.
